# MyEVStation

> Veteran-led EV charging infrastructure and station partnership opportunities in India. Founded by Ex-Indian Air Force.

MyEVStation helps prospective partners explore electric vehicle charging station models and understand the practical questions involved before investing. Options include no-land host-location models, landowner and commercial-property sites, housing-society charging, and an ex-servicemen-focused business opportunity. Site suitability, costs, availability, commercial terms and returns depend on technical assessment and written agreements. Illustrative figures are not guaranteed.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://myevstation-9rj8.vercel.app/): EV charging station models, technology overview, investment calculator and partner options.
- [No-land model](https://myevstation-9rj8.vercel.app/without-land): Indicative equipment packages, charger prices and operating assumptions.
- [Landowners](https://myevstation-9rj8.vercel.app/with-land): Site assessment considerations for plots, commercial properties, parking areas and fleet locations.
- [Housing societies](https://myevstation-9rj8.vercel.app/society): Smart sockets, AC and DC charger options, indicative equipment pricing and installation planning.
- [Ex-servicemen](https://myevstation-9rj8.vercel.app/ex-servicemen): Veteran-focused opportunity overview, illustrative packages and site assessment process.
- [XML sitemap](https://myevstation-9rj8.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Public indexable pages.
